observations: The shared coordinate is 390 feet from the generalized matched Contoocook flowline and 284 feet from mapped water; coverage is complete.

decision: Keep the exact Forest Society coordinate as the conditional outfitter access-area marker. Preserve review status, and require confirmation of operator access and shuttle coverage before staging, especially for the two longer Henniker routes.
